Callout.Name: Suspicious Activity at an ATM
Callout.Message: People loitering around an ATM with tools.
Callout.Advisory: Two suspects, tools visible, no offence seen yet.

Script.Line: Two of them, and they have been at that machine since the bank shut.
One has a bag of tools and the other one is watching the road.
They are drilling it. You can hear it from the bus stop.

Lines.Approach: Two of them and something long in a bag. They have not touched the machine yet.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
